column1: # ZAP baseline rules (zap-baseline.py -c). Every alert fails the scan
# unless listed here as IGNORE or INFO, with the reason on the line above.
# Informational: ZAP noting a JavaScript application, nothing to fix.
# localStorage holds only the theme choice (light, dark, system).
# XSRF-TOKEN is read by the page to send it back (Laravel CSRF, ADR-0016);
# the session cookie is HttpOnly. Re-check if this alert names another cookie.
# style-src allows 'unsafe-inline' for the UI library's inline styles:
# accepted in ADR-0016 (scripts need a nonce); a residual risk to remove.
# ZAP files every CSP finding under this id, so the rest of the policy is
# held by SecurityHeadersTest (nonce scripts, no unsafe-eval, object-src none).
